# ageid.cz — Zero-Data SD-JWT & OID4VP Age Assurance Sandbox

> Client-side testbed and developer sandbox for zero-data age assurance compliant with EU Digital Services Act (DSA) Article 28 and eIDAS 2.0 / EUDI Wallet specifications.

## Core Architecture
- **Zero Data Footprint:** Entirely in-memory via Web Crypto API (`window.crypto.subtle`). No backend database, zero telemetry, no cookies.
- **Privacy Design:** Prevents GDPR Art. 5 controller liabilities by proving attributes mathematically without disclosing personal identifiers (PII).
- **Standards:**
  - RFC 9901 (Selective Disclosure for JWT / SD-JWT)
  - OID4VP 1.0 (OpenID for Verifiable Presentations)
  - Digital Credentials Query Language (DCQL)
  - EUDI Architecture and Reference Framework (ARF) v3.0

## Verified Claims Supported
- `age_over_18` (EU DSA Art. 28 adult content restriction)
- `age_over_13` (COPPA / US KIDS Act)
- `age_over_15` (France / EU social media compliance)
- `age_over_21` (US / strict age verification)
